Five stars doesn't mean good. It never did.

Kevin explains why he tests things himself instead of leaning on what a crowd says. His example is a restaurant: you try the food and decide for yourself whether it's any good.

He applies the same idea to movies. If you skip one only because somebody else didn't like it, you let their opinion make the decision for you.

His last example is a food delivery app, where he says McDonald's tends to collect five-star ratings. His point: judge for yourself.

When did you last trust your own judgment over a crowd?
